diagnostic_persisted_attribution.interpretation: Persisted wall-time/event intervals overlap; do not sum phases/actors/providers or call ACTIVE CPU.

diagnostic_operations.scope: Pass-through canonical _read_bytes includes snapshot open/read and temporary verification; _replace_file includes native source-open/rename/close/fallback. Thread CPU is charged to calling thread, not exclusive backend CPU. Inclusive intervals may overlap across threads; do not add them to phase times or infer historical causation. Observer bookkeeping is partial direct overhead, not total perturbation proof.

diagnostic_observer.scope: Two native bundles just outside original clocks; direct query screen is not full perturbation/host-idleness proof. Native self-process CPU/IO excludes Git/tool child processes.
